statement: A_E is controlled by the extra-sector l=2 residual after EH/GR baseline subtraction.
The extra residual is zero if all named residual subchannels vanish in the same source/coframe/baseline convention.
If the local weak-field operator is exactly EH in the public branch, the non-EH/R11 l=2 operator residual vanishes.
formula: E_local=E_EH through l=2 weak-field order => DeltaE_R11_l2=0

statement: If source labels/weights are forgotten by the public source functor, there is no extra l=2 source-prefactor residual.
If no non-Hilbert/torsion/bypass current couples to the public metric, the non-Hilbert l=2 source residual vanishes.
formula: J_nonHilbert projected to public l=2 = 0 => DeltaT_NH_l2=0

statement: If the parent symplectic/boundary flux has no extra l=2 piece, boundary flux does not feed A_E.
If identity readout has no post-variation re-entry, readout does not reappear inside the residual source current.
